reviews.text: Popped by today to pick up some firewood for the weekend. Spent $20 and got a truck full of good size wood. No complaints and the staff were friendly and very efficient. Thanks!

We buy all of our flagstone and decorative stones from Vega. They have a great selection of reasonably priced goods. They are happy to let you look through as many rocks as you want to find exactly what you need. They never push but when you are ready, they are available. I’ve had them deliver big loads of stone on three locations. They bring your purchase and put them where you want them. Everyone is nice. Great store.

Vega Pools is top of the line and built my dream pool.
After meeting with 4 other pool companies I was lucky to meet Shawn of Vega Pools.  The previous four companies offered cookie cutter pools at huge prices.  Shawn let me design my pool then made practical changes.  The final pool was so exquisite I was thrilled.
